calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-06-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Trish Abalos.
Petitioners: Son Kim Truong and Linh Kiet Phung, are present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the three Minors: Chau Thuyen Truong, Tran Ngoc Truong and Nguyen Buu Truong.
Petitioners were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the Minors were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Tracy Chau Truong, Nancy Tran Truong and Nelson Nguyen Truong.
Decree signed in open court.
